definitions.explanation: Asks which of the seven weekdays something falls on. It asks only for the weekday name, not the calendar date, which is {何日|なんにち}.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{何曜日|なんようび}ですか。
examples.english: What day of the week is it today?

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}は{何曜日|なんようび}にありますか。
examples.english: What day of the week is the exam on?

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}の{十日|とおか}が{何曜日|なんようび}か、カレンダーで{確|たし}かめてください。
examples.english: Please check on the calendar what day of the week the tenth of next month falls on.

notes:
Formed from {何|なん} (what) plus {曜日|ようび} (day of the week).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今日|きょう}は{何曜日|なんようび}: what day is it today
- {何曜日|なんようび}がいい: which day works for you
- {何曜日|なんようび}に: on what day of the week

ANSWERING:
The answer is one of {月曜日|げつようび}, {火曜日|かようび}, {水曜日|すいようび}, {木曜日|もくようび}, {金曜日|きんようび}, {土曜日|どようび}, {日曜日|にちようび}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何日|なんにち}: what date — asks for the day of the month, not the weekday
